notes.title: We adjust out game level balance
notes.content:
- We have no idea how our game is hard to finish

- Also, not like developer, ordinary players couldn't find a way ahead

- So, We resize some object to climb

- And add arrows that indicate where to go


- Actually we didn't want to tell you a way, but our level design and map design was not that appropriate.

Now you can enjoy a little bit more easier.

Don't be panic

You can End This Game.





Note.

If your character doesn't rotate along right and left, Check Option "Mouse Sensitivity"
